criteria.description: Establishes the Scope Management Plan as the primary Baseline-Substantiating Plan forming the foundational root node (depends_on: []) in the planning causal DAG (5.1 Scope -> 6.1 Schedule -> 7.1 Cost); inherits ADR-012 frontmatter specification and authentic PMBOK 8 Scope domain under Planning focus area; mandates explicit in-scope and out-of-scope boundaries (requiring a non-empty, lint-checkable >= 10-word rationale when 'None: [rationale]' is declared); sets route-differentiated word count floors (180 for pmp_section, 700 for full_plan) and caps (750 for pmp_section, 4,500 for full_plan) with Unicode tokenization; preserves lean pmp_section agility by making full WBS dictionary tables and RTM matrices optional for embedded sections while requiring a concise hierarchy line and DoD summary; defines disjunctive variance thresholds (<= 1 SP or minor localized refactoring with zero architectural impact) with formal Stage 17 Integrated Change Control (approve-adaptation-plan) for structural expansions; establishes symmetric rejection governance across approve-pmp and approve-subsidiary-plan with transitive downstream invalidation per ADR-013 Â§4.5; strictly adheres to ADR-001, ADR-002, ADR-005, ADR-008, ADR-011, ADR-012, ADR-013, and ADR-034.

Two genuine alternatives evaluated and rejected with sound architectural rationales: allowing scope to be inferred from user stories without a plan (rejected for inverting governance and causing unanchored scope creep) and combining scope and schedule into a single document (rejected for violating LL-015 component credit assignment).

Honest disclosure of positive benefits (defends the baseline, deterministic causal anchor for schedule and cost, automated linter rules) against negative trade-offs (authoring burden of upfront boundary definition and exclusion itemization before implementation).

Clearly bounds scope and discloses open questions in Section 8 (automated WBS extraction from User Story markdown artifacts deferred to future tooling enhancements); complete amendment log tracking four review rounds.
